comment: Vendor-pointer-generalization Phase 1: convert ssh-manager to a src-passthrough vendor pointer (dev-branch authoring change only; materialize_main.py still expands it into a real, byte-identical copy at promotion, so no user-visible behavior changes). Also corrects canonical libs/ssh-manager/pyproject.toml's name/build-system/test-runner-constraint fields, which had drifted from what every real copy already established (a pre-existing gap: no tool previously synced these fields between canonical and copies).
